title: Some turtles BREATHE through their BUTTS?! 🐢 #shorts
description:
Gizmo Jr. says he knows every animal secret… wrong again. 🤖
Fizzo brought three animal facts that sound fake but are 100% true. ⚡

Which one got you? Comment below! 👇
Follow for a new mind-blowing fact every day!

#facts #funfacts #didyouknow #animals #shorts
facts_checked: Some turtles (e.g. Australia's Fitzroy River turtle) can take in oxygen from water through their cloaca, their rear opening, so they can stay underwater for a long time (cloacal respiration).
Dolphins sleep with half their brain at a time (unihemispheric sleep), often keeping one eye open, so they can keep swimming and come up to breathe.
Wood frogs freeze solid in winter: their heart and breathing stop, and they thaw and come back to life in spring.
